exposure: Time after birth (within 1 hour, 1-5 hours, 6-12 hours)
cohort: 150 women aged 18-49 years who gave birth by caesarean section
finding: Caesarean sections were associated with reduced breastfeeding rates in the first hour after surgery.
mod_finding: 95 (63.3%) of women who had a caesarean section did not breastfeed within the first hour after birth.
